questions.question: The base and perpenducular of a right angled triangle is 12 cm and 5 cm respectively. Find the circum-radius (in cm) of the triangle.
questions.solution:
Base of the right angled triangle = 12

Perpendicular of the right-angled triangle = 5

By Pythagoras theorem

Hypotenuse of the right-angled triangle = 13

We know, circum-radius of right angled triangle = 1/2 × hypotenuse

∴ Circum-radius of right angled triangle = 1/2 × 13 = 6.5 cm

The income of P, Q and R are in the ratio of 5 : 4 : 3 respectively and their expenses are in the ratio of 6 : 5 : 4 respectively. If P saves Rs. 4000 out of an income of Rs. 10000, then what will be the saving (in Rs) of Q?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

Income = Expenses + Savings

**Calculation:**

Let the income of P, Q & R be 5x, 4x, and 3x respectively and their expenses are 6y, 5y, and 4y respectively.

Income of P = 10,000 (given)

⇒ 5x = 10,000

⇒ x = 2,000

According to the question

⇒ 5x – 6y = 4,000

⇒ 10,000 – 6y = 4,000

⇒ 6y = 6,000

⇒ y = 1,000

Saving of the Q = Income of Q – expenses of Q = 4 × 2000 – 5 × 1000 = 8000 – 5000 = 3000

**∴ The saving of the Q is Rs. 3,000**

questions.question: X and Y are two alloys which are prepared by mixing zinc and aluminium in the ratio of 1 : 4 and 11 : 8 respectively. If equal quantities of alloys are melted to form a third alloy Z then what is the ratio of zinc and aluminium in alloy Z?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Ratio of zinc and aluminium in alloy X = 1 : 4 = 5 unit

Ratio of zinc and aluminium in alloy Y = 11 : 8 = 19 unit

We have to equal quantities

Ratio of zinc and aluminium in alloy X = 1 : 4 = 5 × 19

Ratio of zinc and aluminium in alloy Y = 11 : 8 = 19 × 5

New ratio of zinc and aluminium in alloy X = 19 : 76 = 95 unit

New ratio of zinc and aluminium in alloy Y = 55 : 40 = 95 unit

**∴ Ratio of zinc and aluminium in alloy Z = (19 + 55) : (76 + 40) = 74 : 116 = 37 : 58**

questions.question: The simple interest on a sum of money is 16/25 of the principal. The number of years is equal to the rate of interest per annum. What is the rate (in percentage) of interest per annum?
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

(1) The simple interest on a sum of money is 16/25 of the principal.

(2) Rate(r) = Time (t)

**Formula used:- ** 

SI = (P × r × t)/100

Where P = Principal SI = Simple interest

**Calculation:-**

Let the Principal be P

⇒ r = t (given)

⇒ SI = (P × r × t)/100

⇒ 16P/25 = (P × r × r)/100 [ t = r ]

∴ r = 4/5 × 10 = 8% 

**∴ The required answer is __8.__**

questions.question: A book is sold at three successive discounts of 20%, 20% and 10%. What is the net discount (in percentage)?
questions.solution:
Given:

The successive discount are 20%, 20% and 10%.

Formula:

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

Where,

X = First discount

Y = Second discount

Calculation:

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

⇒ 20 + 20 - 400/100

⇒ 36%

Now, again

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

X = 36%, Y = 10%

⇒ 36 + 10 - (36 × 10)/100

⇒ 46 - 3.6 

⇒ 42.4%

∴ The single equivalent discount is 42.4%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png] 

Let MP of the book be 100

SP after discount

⇒ = 100 times frac{{100 - 20}}{{100}} times frac{{100 - 20}}{{100}} times frac{{100 - 10}}{{100}} 

⇒ = 100 times frac{{80}}{{100}} times frac{{80}}{{100}} times frac{{90}}{{100}} = 57.6 

We know, discount = MP – SP 

So, net discount = 100 – 57.6 = 42.4

∴ Discount % = 42.4/100 × 100 = 42.4

questions.question: Rashika can do a work in 5 days. Rashmi can do the same work in 7 days. Both of them finish the work together and they get Rs. 240 for the work. What is the share (in Rs.) of Rashika?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Wages are distributed in the ratio of efficiency, which is the inverse of the time taken.

Time ratio of Rashika and Rashmi = 5 : 7

Efficiency ratio (Rashika : Rashmi) = 7 : 5

Total efficiency = 7 + 5 = 12 parts = ₹240

1 part = ₹20 ⇒ Rashika's share = 7 parts = 7 × 20 = ₹140

**∴ The correct answer is ₹140.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Calculations:**

⇒ Ratio of efficiencies (Rashika : Rashmi) = 7 : 5

⇒ Total efficiency parts = 7 + 5 = 12 parts

Work and Wages

Wages are distributed in proportion to the total work done by individuals. If individuals work for the same number of days, wages are distributed directly in the ratio of their daily efficiencies.

Efficiency and Time Relationship

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time. If persons A and B take time in the ratio x : y, their efficiencies will be in the ratio y : x.

Combined Work Formula

If A can do a work in x days and B in y days, together they take (x × y) ÷ (x + y) days to complete the whole work.

questions.question: 1/3 part of a certain journey is covered with the speed of 25 km/hr, 1/2 part of the journey is covered with the speed of 45 km/hr and the remaining part covered with the speed of 37.5 km/hr. What is the average speed (in km/hr) for the whole journey?
questions.solution:
**Given:- **

(1) 1/3 part of a certain journey is covered at the speed of 25 km/hr

(2) 1/2 part of the journey is covered at the speed of 45 km/hr

(3) the remaining part is covered with a speed of 37.5 km/hr.

**Formula used:-**

(1) Time = distance/speed

(2) Average speed = total distance/total time 

**Calculation:-**

Let total part of journey = 6 km (LCM of 2 & 3)

(1/3 part of 6) 2 km covered with the speed = 25 km/hr

We know, time = distance/speed

Time is taken to cover 2 km = 2/25

(1/2 part of 6) 3 km covered with the speed = 45 km/h

Similarly, time = 3/45

Remaining part = 6 – 2 – 3 = 1

1 km covered with the speed = 37.5 km/h

Similarly, time = 1/37.5

We know, average speed = total distance/total time

∴ Average speed = (6)/({frac{2){{25}} + (3)/({45)} + (1)/({37.5)}}} = frac{{6 times 75}}{{6 + 5 + 2}} = frac{{450}}{{13}} = 34.61 km/hr

**∴ The required answer is __34.61__.**

questions.question: If in the following year sectors A, B and C grew by 9% and the remaining sectors grew by 3%, how much did the overall economy grow by?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Sectors A, B and C grew by 9% and sectors D, E, F and G grew by 3%.

So, Increase in GDP of sectors A, B and C = (A + B + C) × 9% = (100 + 40 + 60) × 9/100 = 18

Similarly increase in GDP of sectors D, E, F & G = (D + E + F + G) × 3%

⇒ (30 + 40 + 65 + 25) × 3/100 = 4.8

So overall growth = 18 + 4.8 = 22.8

Total GDP before growth = 360

**So, overall growth % = 22.8/360 × 100 = 6.33%**

questions.question: The area of a square is 30.25 cm². Find its perimeter (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given:- **

The area of a square is 30.25 cm². 

**Formula used:- **

(1) Area of a square = a2 

(2) Perimeter of a square = 4a

**Calculation:-**

We know, the area of a square = a²

⇒ a² = 30.25

⇒ a = 5.5

∴ Perimeter of a square = 4a = 4 × 5.5 = 22 

**∴ The required answer is __22__.**

questions.question: The circumference of a circle is 110 cm. Find its radius (in cm).
questions.solution:

The circumference of a circle is 110 cm 

**Formula used:- **

The circumference of a circle = 2πr

**Calculation:-**

We know, the circumference of a circle = 2πr

⇒ 2πr = 110

⇒ 2 × 22/7 × r = 110

∴ r = 17.5 cm 

**∴ The required answer is __17.5__.**
